evals.name: add-page-reachable-from-rail
evals.prompt: Add a /tasks/{id} detail page to this taskboard app that you can reach from the rail nav and from each task row. The page shows the task title and status. Files are server.go, layout.tmpl and board.tmpl.
evals.expected_output: Adds a handler that declares its response shape and reads htmx headers through one helper rather than hand-typed strings; sets Vary: HX-Request where the body depends on it; extracts the repeated nav-link attribute bundle into a named {{define}} partial and uses it for the new link; keeps a real href.

assertions.text: Introduces or uses a single helper/const set for htmx headers instead of hand-typed header strings in the new handler
Sets Vary: HX-Request (or equivalent) on a route whose body depends on HX-Request
Extracts the repeated nav-link attribute bundle into a named {{define}} partial and uses it for the new link(s)
New links keep a real href so they work without JS

evals.name: non-htmx-form-post-redirect
evals.prompt: When JS is off, submitting the new-task form re-renders the board, and refreshing the page asks to resubmit. Fix createTask in server.go and the form in board.tmpl.
evals.expected_output: Form gets a real action and method; non-htmx POST answers 303 See Other to GET /; htmx POST returns a fragment or HX-Location, never a 3xx; invalid input re-renders with 422 rather than a plain-text 400.

assertions.text: Non-htmx POST responds with 303 See Other to a GET route
Form has a real action and method attribute so it works without htmx
htmx POST does not receive a 3xx redirect; it gets a fragment or HX-Location/HX-Redirect

evals.name: refused-archive-fails-silently
evals.prompt: Clicking Archive on a running task does nothing at all, no message. Users think the button is broken. Make the refusal show up. See server.go archive and the templates.
evals.expected_output: Explains htmx 2.x does not swap 4xx bodies by default; adds a responseHandling entry (via meta htmx-config) to swap the chosen status (422) AND has the server set HX-Retarget/HX-Reswap to a persistent flash region with aria-live, swapped by innerHTML; returns HTML not plain text; no inline script.

assertions.text: Diagnoses that htmx 2.x does not swap 4xx/5xx responses by default
Configures responseHandling (or equivalent) so the refusal status is swapped, without an inline <script>
Server sets HX-Retarget and HX-Reswap to send the error to a known region
The error region is a persistent aria-live region swapped via innerHTML, not replaced with outerHTML

evals.name: poll-without-clobbering-input
evals.prompt: The task list in board.tmpl refreshes every 5s but it keeps wiping what I'm typing into the new-task box. Fix it so the list stays live.
evals.expected_output: Moves the input/form outside the polled target (or splits the region); adds hx-sync to the poller; adds a focus/visibility pause guard in a client module rather than an inline trigger filter; polls a dedicated rows route.

assertions.text: Moves the input out of the polled swap target (or splits the region) rather than only patching around it
Adds hx-sync to the polling element
Adds a pause guard (focus or document.hidden) implemented outside the template, not as an inline script or eval trigger filter

evals.name: collapse-rail-click-handler
evals.prompt: Make the rail collapse button remember its state across htmx navigations, and while you're there tidy up the scripts in layout.tmpl.
evals.expected_output: Removes inline <script> blocks and onclick. Persists the collapse server-side (a preference endpoint re-rendering the rail) or uses a native element, rather than a DOM script with localStorage. Active-link state is rendered by the server (aria-current, or hx-swap-oob) instead of an afterSwap listener. htmx config moves to meta htmx-config. Any remaining JS is limited to the htmx glue set.

assertions.text: Removes every inline <script> block and onclick attribute from layout.tmpl
Persists the collapsed state on the server or uses a native HTML element, not a hand-written DOM behaviour with localStorage
Active nav state is rendered by the server (aria-current or hx-swap-oob) rather than toggled by a client listener
Moves htmx config into a <meta name="htmx-config"> tag

evals.name: status-badge-eq-chain
evals.prompt: Add a 'cancelled' status to the task badges in board.tmpl; cancelled should look like failed.
evals.expected_output: Replaces the eq chain with a view-model field (e.g. Badge{Class, Label}) computed in Go; adds cancelled there; template only reads the field.

assertions.text: Moves status-to-badge mapping into Go (a view-model field or method) instead of adding another eq branch
Template reads presentation fields only, with no domain-word eq chain left

evals.name: interactive-task-graph-island
evals.prompt: Add a dependency graph of tasks to the board in board.tmpl — nodes you can drag around and zoom, and dropping a node onto another should record that dependency. The web/ folder already builds Solid components with Vite.
evals.expected_output: Builds the graph as a Solid island mounted via a data-island container and htmx.onLoad, unmounted on htmx:beforeCleanupElement. Initial graph data comes from the server as a Go value inside <script type="application/json">. The container has hx-preserve and a stable id so polling swaps don't destroy it. Recording a dependency goes back through hypermedia (a CustomEvent an hx-trigger listens for, or a form), not a JSON fetch. Defers in-island code style to frontend-best-practices.

assertions.text: Implements the graph as a framework island (Solid component) rather than hand-written DOM manipulation
Mounts via htmx.onLoad (or equivalent) and unmounts on swap/cleanup
Initial data comes from the server-rendered HTML (application/json script or data-*), not a client fetch of a JSON API
Records the dependency through a hypermedia exchange (htmx-triggered request or form), with the server re-rendering HTML
Protects the island from the 5s poll swap (hx-preserve with stable id, or placed outside the polled region)
